## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Failure-report matching should use the same path normalization as the existing selectors so it includes requested failures reported with a `./` prefix.

## Changes
The pull request adds a selector for failed paths in runner reports and tests for all three selectors. It also refactors the cached selector while preserving its behavior.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Normalize failure paths before matching — A report containing `./tests/test_x.py` returns no match for a request containing `tests/test_x.py`. The new selector compares raw paths, while both existing selectors strip the `./` prefix before matching. — A rerun can omit a requested failing test when the report and request spell its path differently. — Fix: Use `normalize(path) in requested` for matching, keep the original path in the result, and extend `test_failure_report_selection`.
